# CloudMetrics Enterprise Analytics Dashboard

CloudMetrics provides infrastructure for real-time observability, telemetry ingestion, and distributed tracing across Kubernetes clusters.

## Automated Root Cause Analysis
Using streaming analytics, CloudMetrics isolates latency spikes and query anomalies before customers notice.

## Pricing & Plans
Pricing starts at $49/month for starter nodes up to $499/month for enterprise clusters.

## Dedicated Engineering Support
Contact us at ops@cloudmetrics-demo.io or visit our engineering office in Austin, Texas.

Built for site reliability engineers, DevOps leads, and cloud architects.
